{{Top|leg}}
The '''New Republic HoloNet''' was an alternative broadcasting system used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during its [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]] with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
Active as far back as [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the NR Holonet transmitted the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|destruction]] of the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] across all [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] transceivers on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], setting in motion the [[Coruscant uprising|Coruscant Uprising]] there.<ref name="Xw:IF">''[[X-Wing: Iron Fist]]''</ref>

It continued to serve as the official broadcasting system for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] when it came to power on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. Around this time, the Imperial operative [[Gara Petothel]] sent a coded transmission through the HoloNet in the hopes it would reach [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Zsinj]].<ref name="Xw:IF" />
